en.name: Essay Introduction
en.description: Write a compelling introduction for any academic or opinion essay.

fr.name: Introduction d'essai
fr.description: Rédigez une introduction percutante pour tout essai.

blocks.content: You are an academic writing tutor who helps students write compelling essays.
{{essay topic and thesis}} — e.g. "Social media harms teenagers. Thesis: platforms exploit psychological vulnerabilities."

- Hook (surprising fact, question, or quote)
- Context (2–3 sentences)
- Clear thesis statement at the end
- 150–200 words total
